messages:
elena: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Short follow-up with clarifications and owners. Main update: Dedicated GA public target = end of Q2 (June 28). Scope: autoscale, canary rollouts, docs, and comms.

sam: Quick q: if autoscale tests fail, what's the communication plan to customers?

elena: We won't GA if major regressions present. We'll announce any slip within 24 hours and share a remediation timeline.

matt: Autoscale plan: 3 storm tests (small/med/large) across regions, cache warm/cold. I'll post matrix Monday. Owner: matt + eng-sre.

jia: Canary plan: ramps (100 orgs -> 1k req/min -> 10k req/min). Eval signals: p95 latency, error rate, token-cost delta. I own pass/fail rules.

lina: Docs: quickstart draft up now. Need SE + techwriter review. I'll add a troubleshooting FAQ section.

doc-bot: Draft: https://confluence.redwood/dedicated-quickstart-draft (comments enabled).

eng-sre: Creating perf dashboard issue with p50/p95/p99. Will link when ready.

elena: Compact action list: matt/eng-sre: autoscale tests (due 2026-06-04); jia: canary evals (due 2026-06-02); lina/docs: quickstart review (due 2026-05-31); elena/product: SLA FAQ + comms (due 2026-06-05).

elena: Links: deck + recording: https://drive.redwood/allhands/may-2026-deck, notes: https://confluence.redwood/allhands-may-2026-notes, evals: https://dash.redwood/evals/dedicated-canary. Ping me to add owners. :thumbsup:
